description: Where PR lead time goes, by team: wait for approval, approval to merge, merge to Resolved. Time range filters on merge time. Copy of the PR approvals & sprint flow dashboard, redesigned.

panels.title: Summary: merged PRs in the selected time range

panels.description: Distinct pull requests merged in the time range (a PR linked to several work items counts once).

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOWorkItemFlowTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Repository:singlequote}) or Repository in (${Repository:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${TargetBranch:singlequote}) or TargetBranch in (${TargetBranch:singlequote})) and Merged ge ${__from:date:seconds} and Merged lt ${__to:date:seconds})/groupby((PullRequestId))&$top=20000

panels.title: PRs merged

panels.description: Mean time from PR creation to the first approval vote (10, from the PR threads), per PR.

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOWorkItemFlowTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Repository:singlequote}) or Repository in (${Repository:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${TargetBranch:singlequote}) or TargetBranch in (${TargetBranch:singlequote})) and Merged ge ${__from:date:seconds} and Merged lt ${__to:date:seconds} and TimeToFirstApproval ne null)/groupby((PullRequestId,TimeToFirstApproval))&$top=20000

panels.title: Wait for first approval

panels.description: Mean time from the first approval to the merge, per PR. Long values point at policy/build gates or extra pushes after approval.

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOWorkItemFlowTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Repository:singlequote}) or Repository in (${Repository:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${TargetBranch:singlequote}) or TargetBranch in (${TargetBranch:singlequote})) and Merged ge ${__from:date:seconds} and Merged lt ${__to:date:seconds} and ApprovalToMerge ne null)/groupby((PullRequestId,ApprovalToMerge))&$top=20000

panels.title: First approval → merge

panels.description: Mean time from merge to the work item reaching Resolved (manual, by the reviewer). Expected ≈30 min.

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOWorkItemFlowTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Repository:singlequote}) or Repository in (${Repository:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${TargetBranch:singlequote}) or TargetBranch in (${TargetBranch:singlequote})) and Merged ge ${__from:date:seconds} and Merged lt ${__to:date:seconds} and MergeToResolved ne null)/groupby((PullRequestId,WorkItemId,MergeToResolved))&$top=20000

panels.title: Merge → Resolved

panels.description: Share of PR–work item links whose iteration changed after the PR was created (from work item history).

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOWorkItemFlowTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Repository:singlequote}) or Repository in (${Repository:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${TargetBranch:singlequote}) or TargetBranch in (${TargetBranch:singlequote})) and Merged ge ${__from:date:seconds} and Merged lt ${__to:date:seconds})/groupby((Organization),aggregate(CarriedOver with average as CarriedShare))&$top=20000

panels.title: Carried over

panels.description: Work items linked to a merged PR that are still not Resolved/Closed more than 24 h after the merge.

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOWorkItemFlowTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Repository:singlequote}) or Repository in (${Repository:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${TargetBranch:singlequote}) or TargetBranch in (${TargetBranch:singlequote})) and Merged ge ${__from:date:seconds} and Merged lt ${__to:date:seconds})/groupby((Organization),aggregate(MergedNotDone with sum as NotDone))&$top=20000

panels.title: Merged, not Resolved
Where PR lead time goes, by team

panels.description: Each bar is a team; segments are the mean wait for first approval, first approval → merge, and merge → Resolved. Sorted by total. Teams come from the work item iteration path; blank = path did not match the team pattern.

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOWorkItemFlowTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Repository:singlequote}) or Repository in (${Repository:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${TargetBranch:singlequote}) or TargetBranch in (${TargetBranch:singlequote})) and Merged ge ${__from:date:seconds} and Merged lt ${__to:date:seconds})/groupby((Team,PullRequestId,WorkItemId,TimeToFirstApproval,ApprovalToMerge,MergeToResolved))&$top=20000

panels.title: Lead time breakdown by team (mean per PR link)

panels.description: One row per team, ranked by mean lead time (created → merged, per PR–work item link). Inline bars compare teams; orange/red cells flag carry-over above 20%/35%, work items still not Resolved 24 h after merge, and package-version mismatches. (A period-over-period trend column needs previous-period data, which the load generator does not have yet.)

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOWorkItemFlowTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Repository:singlequote}) or Repository in (${Repository:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${TargetBranch:singlequote}) or TargetBranch in (${TargetBranch:singlequote})) and Merged ge ${__from:date:seconds} and Merged lt ${__to:date:seconds})/groupby((Team,PullRequestId,WorkItemId,Created,Merged,TimeToFirstApproval,CarriedOver,MergedNotDone,VersionMismatch))&$top=20000

panels.title: Team hot spots

panels.description: Merged PRs per ISO week (Monday start): median created → merged (blue), slowest PR of the week (dashed orange) and number of merged PRs (grey bars, right axis). Use the Team filter to compare a team with the rest. Detail per PR: collapsed table at the bottom.

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOWorkItemFlowTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Repository:singlequote}) or Repository in (${Repository:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${TargetBranch:singlequote}) or TargetBranch in (${TargetBranch:singlequote})) and Merged ge ${__from:date:seconds} and Merged lt ${__to:date:seconds})/groupby((PullRequestId),aggregate(Merged with max as MergedAt,Created with max as CreatedAt))&$top=20000

panels.title: PR lead time per week

panels.description: Distinct merged PRs by days before the end of the team sprint they merged in (0 = last day). A tall right edge means work lands at the deadline. PRs without a matching team calendar are excluded.

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOWorkItemFlowTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Repository:singlequote}) or Repository in (${Repository:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${TargetBranch:singlequote}) or TargetBranch in (${TargetBranch:singlequote})) and Merged ge ${__from:date:seconds} and Merged lt ${__to:date:seconds} and MergedSprintFinish ne null)/groupby((PullRequestId),aggregate(Merged with max as M,MergedSprintFinish with max as Finish))&$top=20000

panels.title: When in the sprint PRs merge

panels.description: A PR linked to multiple teams counts once for each team. Team totals are memberships, not a global distinct-PR total. Team comes from iteration paths; AreaPath is a separate filter.

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOWorkItemFlowTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Repository:singlequote}) or Repository in (${Repository:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${TargetBranch:singlequote}) or TargetBranch in (${TargetBranch:singlequote})) and Merged ge ${__from:date:seconds} and Merged lt ${__to:date:seconds} and MergedSprintPath ne null and MergedSprintPath ne '' and Team ne null and Team ne '')/groupby((MergedSprintPath,Team,PullRequestId))

panels.title: PRs per merge sprint by team

panels.description: Top 100 merged PRs by lead time, with the approval split and the linked work item state and version.

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOWorkItemFlowTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Repository:singlequote}) or Repository in (${Repository:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${TargetBranch:singlequote}) or TargetBranch in (${TargetBranch:singlequote})) and Merged ge ${__from:date:seconds} and Merged lt ${__to:date:seconds})/groupby((Organization,Project,PullRequestId,Repository,Team,TargetBranch,WorkItemId,State,TargetPackageVersion,CarriedOver,Created,Merged,TimeToFirstApproval,ApprovalToMerge,MergeToResolved))&$top=20000
